tenacious_tuna 2026/10/16 00:55
这是一种非常令人愉快的体验，将人们在计算机上所做的事情的感觉推向了实际坐在办公桌前并必须伸手去操作各种功能的感觉。我觉得这将使空间记忆能够做一些很酷的事情。

我怀念 90 年代厚重的开关、按钮、硬件：能够听到计算机“思考”（HDD 寻找）、CRT 的嗡嗡声。现代机械感觉如此虚无，强调干净的玻璃和整洁的机加工底盘。 （底盘？）

我一直梦想着一台计算机设置，感觉就像《异形》中的诺斯特罗莫飞行甲板。当我坐在办公桌前时，我几乎想要感觉自己正坐在一台电脑里，周围都是带有大量开关等的强大感觉电子设备。当然，那里也有很多不便，但其中的一些东西吸引了我。

This is a really enjoyable take, pushing the feeling of what one does on a computer towards actually being at a desk and having to reach for various functions. I feel like that would enable spatial memory to do some cool things.

I miss the 90s chunkiness of switches, buttons, hardware: being able to hear the computer "think" (HDD seeks), the hum of a CRT. Modern machinery feels so insubstantial, emphasizing clean glass and tidy machined chassis. (chassies?)

I have this persistent daydream about a computer setup that feels like the Nostromo flight deck from Alien. I almost want to feel like I'm sitting _inside_ a computer when I'm at my desk, surrounded by powerful feeling electronics with substantial switches and such. Of course there's plenty of inconvenience there too, but something about it appeals to me.

That's one of the appeals of mechanical keyboards for me. It's primarily the visual and aural aesthetic (thock thock thock....or clack clack clack) but married to the silent billion or so switches frantically turning on or off on the PC next to me, it kind of gives me the tactile feedback that I want from the process.

adjejmxbdjdn 2026/10/16 23:23
这对米尔顿·弗里德曼（Milton Friedman）不公平，他与美国不同。右翼重述他的经济学，可能会对现代不平等和权力集中的水平感到震惊。

他确实支持基本上是累进税，但建议将其构建为负税，即不随收入增加税率，而是采用固定税率和最低限度的扣除额，但当你沿着收入阶梯下降时征收负税。

That’s unfair to Milton Friedman who, unlike the America. right wing retelling of his economics, would likely be aghast at the modern levels of inequality and concentration of power.

He did support what was basically progressive taxation, but suggested structuring it as a negative tax, where instead of increasing tax rates with income, you had a flat tax rate with minimal deductions, but you imposed a negative tax as you went down the income ladder.

embedding-shape 2026/10/16 22:28
> 比这稍微复杂一点

关键字是“一点”。这是上次访问时设置的 cookie。

 $ document.cookie
    > HN=1
删除cookie，然后打开新选项卡，复制粘贴链接，它就可以正常工作了。这不是火箭科学，至少以前不是:)
> It's a little more complicated than that

Keyword being "a little". It's a cookie set on previous visit.

    $ document.cookie
    > HN=1
Delete the cookie, then open new tab, copy-paste the link and it works just fine. It's not rocket science, at least it didn't used to be :)
